Subject: Beacon Headlamps are back in stock
Preview: 210 units available. 400 lumens, 40-hour runtime, 95 grams.
Body: Whether you're doing a pre-dawn alpine start or a multi-night route where recharging isn't guaranteed to be convenient, you already know what you need from a headlamp.

The Northbay Beacon (NB-LMP-05) is back in stock — 210 units on hand right now.

Here's what it does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough for trail navigation, camp tasks, and reading a map at arm's length.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime, so a three- or four-night trip won't leave you rationing light on the last morning.
• USB-C rechargeable, which means one cable handles it alongside your other gear.
• 95 grams on your head, not 150.

A note on scope: the Beacon is built for trail and camp use. It's not rated for technical caving or diving environments.

If it's been on your list, now's a straightforward time to grab one.
